Programme Overview

The International Max Planck Research School for Quantum Science and Technology (IMPRS-QST) and the Munich Quantum Valley (MQV) announce the open call for several fully funded PhD fellowships. We invite passionate and dedicated young professionals to seize this career opportunity and join us for their PhD in quantum science and technology.

About IMPRS and MQV

IMPRS is a collaboration between the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics, Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München, and the Technical University of Munich. MQV is dedicated to advancing quantum science and quantum technologies in Bavaria.

Fields of Research

  • Atomic physics and quantum optics
  • Solid-state physics and material science
  • Quantum information theory
  • Quantum many-body systems
  • Quantum-related fields of electrical engineering and computer science

Who Should Apply

Candidates with a Master's degree (or equivalent) to be completed by the end of September 2026. All PhD positions are fully funded for three years. No tuition fees.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application period opens15 October 2026
Application deadline15 January 2027

Application Portal

https://application.imprs-quantum.mpg.de/public/

Important Notes

  • Common application platform of IMPRS-QST and MQV.
  • In registration, indicate: IMPRS-QST, MQV, or Both.
  • Selection processes are simultaneous but independent.
